---
title: Fish Soup with Ditalini
id: MAR-0087
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 50
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 1 scorpionfish, 500 g, ready for cooking
- 200 g ditalini
- 250 g ramati tomatoes
- 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
- 2 shallots
- 1 tablespoon chopped parsley
- to taste salt and pepper
## Method
1. Blanch the tomatoes in lightly salted water.
2. Drain them, peel them, cut them into quarters, remove the seeds and chop the pulp.
3. Peel and slice the shallots, let them wilt in a saucepan with the oil for 3 minutes, add the tomato pulp and 8 dl of water, bring to a boil, salt and let cook for 10 minutes.
4. Add the fish, cook for about 10 minutes, then drain it, bone it and break the flesh into pieces.
5. Add the pasta to the sauce and cook until done.
6. Turn off the heat, distribute the preparation among plates, place the fish on top and sprinkle with parsley and a grind of pepper.
